sorry_inventory.assumption: nf_eval_nf M (k'+2) 2 [x,t] sub_nf from 1-var NF data + order
sorry_inventory.why_deferred: Non-constant env gap. Requires bracket-formula encoding or Prior compositionality (500+ lines).

memory_candidates.content: ih_exist (ExistPart at lower depth) only works with CONSTANT parent env. For non-constant env [x,t] in the Until/Since zones, ih_exist gives existentials at [y,x,x] not [y,x,t]. The transfer from [x,x] to [x,t] requires the full 2-var NF as precondition (circular). Top/bot encoding preserves sorry-free forward but carries no backward information.

generalExistPart_from_classical produces top/bot formula correct GIVEN the full NF precondition. Using it in the backward direction is circular (need NF to use NF). The cross-structure transfer (nf_extend_fwd/bwd) also requires the full NF precondition at arity 2.
